title: Open source 160 sound visualization experiments
title_zh: 开源的 160 项声音可视化实验

paragraphs.en: 160+ sound visualization experiments across 25+ categories. explore waveform animations, spectrum-inspired patterns, matrix displays, particles, rhythm and memory.
paragraphs.zh: 25+ 个类别中的 160+ 个声音可视化实验。探索波形动画、频谱启发的图案、矩阵显示、粒子、节奏与记忆。
